title: AWS Backup Vault + Plan
scenario: Create a backup vault and a nightly backup plan that targets it.
constraints: Create aws_backup_plan with a cron rule.

focus.title: Complete the aws_backup_plan resource
focus.todo: Add the arguments and nested blocks required for aws_backup_plan.

hints.why: `aws_backup_vault` is a real building block in production configurations. The exercise isolates one decision so you can recognise the same shape when it appears inside a larger module.
hints.what: Complete the marked TODO in `main.tf`. Add the arguments and nested blocks required for aws_backup_plan. Use the visible constraints as your checklist before you run the tests.
hints.when: Use this pattern when the requirement is part of a reusable configuration that another person or environment must be able to reproduce.
hints.how: Open `main.tf` and work inside the single TODO region. Change one requirement at a time: add the named block, argument or reference, then run the tests. When a check fails, match its wording to the constraints and fix only the block it names.
